title: Moving from Simple to Advanced mode
text: Hi, I'm Rohan from Humanitarians AI. This is part two. In part one, you made a song in simple mode, one box, and one button. This video is the advanced tab, every control gives you, what each one does, and when you actually need it. Here is the whole idea. Advanced is the same generator with the lid off. Simple

title: Custom lyrics with Verse and Chorus tags
text: Handso one sentence and lets it decide the rest. Advanced breaks that into individual controls. What the song sounds like, what it sings, and how strictly it follows you. Nothing here is required. Each control is a decision you take back from the model. The first box is lyrics, what the song actually says.

title: Writing comma-separated style tags
text: In advanced, you write it yourself. Mark each section with verse or chorus in square brackets alone on its own line, and Sunno treats what follows as that section. There is also a button that drafts lyrics for you if you want a starting point. Below it is the styles box. What the song sounds like written

title: Exclude styles and slider controls
text: As commaepparated tags rather than a sentence. Name the genre, then the instruments, then the production. Acoustic folk, fingerpicked guitar, brushed drums, warm, intimate. title: Best practices: Iterating one change at a time
text: Lyrics box. Write where you type the words yourself. Prompt where you describe them and Sunno writes them. And instrumental for no vocals at all. Next is exclude styles, the field for anything you do not want in the track. Vocal gender picks male or female. Leave it untouched and Sunno decides. Then two sliders, both starting at 50%. Weirdness runs from safe to chaos. how conventional the result is willing to be. Style influence runs from loose to strong. How literally Sunseo follows your styles tags. Raise it when a tag keeps getting ignored. Last in more options is duration sitting on auto. Switch to custom when you need a specific length. Below more options, song title is optional. Leave it blank and names the track. Save to puts the result in a chosen workspace. create sits pinned at the foot of the panel the whole time. Press

It. You now have a lot of controls, which makes one habit more important, not less. When a track comes back wrong, change one thing and generate again. Change the styles, the sliders, and the lyrics all at once, and the result cannot tell you which change did it. To review, styles is what it sounds like as commaepparated tags. Lyrics is what it says. Write prompt or instrumental with sections in square brackets. More options holds exclude styles, vocal gender, and the two sliders. Duration, title, and workspace sit at the bottom and change one thing at a time. That is the advanced tab end to end. Part three covers the features around it. Adding your own voice to the mix, the sounds tab for effects and loops, the inspo button, and what to do with a track once you have one you like. Rohan VJ Kumar, humanitarians AI
